notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[b]Summary[/b]: Fixed a bug that over-counts verses if repeated. Press 's' on options menu to Synchronize Dictionaries.

Thanks for playing Word. God loves you like crazy!!

[b]Details[/b]:
A previous update introduced a bug:
Verses that have already been counted as typed (for book, Testament, Bible) were being counted again (if typed again); the result is the game could show you have typed more verses than there are for a book or testament if you had typed some of the verses more than once.

This has been corrected.

If you want the game to recount (correct) total verses for each book plus OT, NT and Entire Bible, simply hold down the 's' key while the options menu is active; this will display a "Synchronize Dictionaries" button which you can click to perform the recount and save the result.

You may wonder how the recount is performed so I will explain it here. There are multiple dictionaries in Word. Player Statistics Dictionary holds reference to each verse you type along with the book and chapter the verse belongs to and your best WPM, mistakes, whether you made zero mistakes and efficiency score; this dictionary is the standard because there are no repeats allowed and so a verse can only be entered once, then it can be updated (if a new WPM is better, for instance). Another smaller dictionary called Completed Verses Dictionary holds reference only to the number of verses completed for each book plus OT and NT; this dictionary is the one the bug affected by incrementing the total number of verses completed when a verse had already been completed. So clicking the Synchronize Dictionaries button will perform a count of all verses in Player Statistics Dictionary and use these accurate numbers to correct the Completed Verses Dictionary which supplies the Progress menu and Choose Testament, Choose Book, Choose Chapter and Choose Verse menus with the completed verses to to display.

The steam stats were likewise overestimated. This will no longer occur but the added verses have not been removed so you may reach the achievement before you actually type all the verses (if you type repeat verses).

Hit me up on the community discussions if you have any questions or comments.

Thanks for playing Word. God loves you like crazy!!

notes.title: Requested feature; Idle after 5 seconds
notes.content:
[b]Idle Mode[/b]
Relax while playing now, with idle mode.
After 5 seconds of no typing, timer is paused and set back to the time of the last keypress; resume typing to continue. You will see text at the bottom of the play screen to indicate idle mode is active.

[b]WPM Logic[/b]
Now, the WPM is calculated every 5 characters (every word) and upon last character / level completion. Previously, WPM was calculated continuously.

[b]Addressing the problems with the Leaderboards[/b]
In a future update, I will introduce logic to reset leaderboards that are obviously wrong:
[list]
[*] 2,147,483,647
[*] WPM of 543 
[/list]

Thanks for your patience and thanks for playing Word!

notes.title: NEW LEADERBOARDS !
notes.content:
1. Total Verses Typed (for the Bible) Leaderboard - increments only when you complete verse(s) you have NOT typed and received credit for and maxes out at 31,103 verses (total verses in the Bible)

2. Total Unique Verses Typed Leaderboard - increments when you complete any verse, even verses already typed and credited - this is your total verses typed of all time


Retrospective - verses you have completed before the creation of these leaderboards is credited

notes.title: Leaderboards and Achievements
notes.content:
View your place on the leaderboards! 
Check your unlocked achievements and progress for locked achievements!

Stats can be viewed by visiting Word's Community page (click "View Stats" at the top right of the page) or by going to the store page and clicking the link next to the "Play Now" [Button]

Word is a unique game.
[list]
[*] Short: Jump in and play one round in a few minutes.
[*] Intermediate: You can play a few rounds while the coffee brews (if you still use a coffee pot OO ) or peruse the menus to get a feel for the scope of the Bible. The progress menu and play menu both show your progress. Inspect the play menus; each button shows your progress (slider) and there is a slider at the bottom of each menu with greater-context progress (completed / total) showing the total number of verses for the Bible, testament, book or chapter depending on the context.
[*] Long: It takes 72 hours (continuous) to read the entire Bible; there are 31,103 verses. It will take time to type the entire Bible. Furthermore, each level should be replayed to improve the score. You could spend years typing the Bible, improving your scores (and typing skills) and learning more about the Bible.
[/list]

So relax and type a verse or two - or drill down and complete a book and receive a star on the progress menu; Jude is a short book near the end of the new testament. 

Check out the video on the community hub to learn more about how the menus inform you.
